uses.quote: Generative AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot can be helpful when you need to identify a topic to research and/or define a research question.
Welcome to the Library’s guide to using Generative Artificial Intelligence (Gen AI) to support your literature searching.

decided_by.quote: Before you use any AI tool to support your assessed work, please check the guidance from your module or course and read the University’s guidance for students on using artificial intelligence in your learning.
